errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the title of the chart. The actual title, visible on the image, is "alle Befragten mit Antwort ja (in %)". The text "Umfrage Gründungsbarrieren" is the figure caption provided in the metadata, not the title on the chart itself.
The phrase "dicht gefolgt von" (closely followed by) introduces a comparison between data points, which the prompt explicitly forbids ("Vermeiden Sie es, ... Vergleiche anzustellen").
